cases.description: AP-05 part A purge oracle (the B06 grep/file half): every Part-A path is gone from the tree; the CMake files and CMakePresets.json no longer name the purged vendored deps, the list(FILTER) partition block, the 3D-only test block, render_3d.cpp, the excluded editor TUs or a 3D (OFF) preset; no 2D-compiled #include reaches a purged header or tree. The remaining COSMIC_2D_ONLY preprocessor uses and the 3D identifiers inside excluded fences are reported, not failed (-AllowFences): part B removes the fences and drops the switch from this manifest, after which B06 must pass strict.
